severity: CRITICAL (blocker classes: neural execution correctness + scientific comparison integrity)
defect: generate_pathb.build_split numbered passage_ids per (family, question-family), so EVERY pid occurred exactly 4x (once per question family; train 12,000 records -> 3,000 unique pids). The P0 run's activation and clause-local caches were keyed by pid, so each pid held only the LAST-generated record's features: ~75% of records were trained and evaluated against ANOTHER passage's activations.
how_found: the PATH-B-A0 probe crashed on an IndexError (a colliding record with a different candidate count), 9.2 min / ~$0.081 into its run -- the fast-fail guards worked.

invalidated_as_evidence.PATHB_P0_RAW_RESULTS.json (commit 5d1ace: PRESERVED but VOID as evidence about the binder: memorization 0.711, the gold-routing inversion 0.133-vs-0.258, PRB-POS 0.8883, the transfer floor, and all four arm accuracies were measured through cross-assigned features.
invalidated_as_evidence.QB_ORD interpretation: the claim that QB_ORD's 0.784 reflected a position shortcut is WITHDRAWN: QB_ORD was generated LAST per family, so its records were the ONLY ones whose cache entries were correct -- it was the only uncorrupted family, which fully explains it being the only family that learned.
invalidated_as_evidence.PRB-POS 0.8883 and the QB-ORD drop: the PRB-POS gate fired on a contaminated measurement. The frozen-gate law was honored at the time; whether QB-ORD re-enters after a CLEAN PRB-POS measurement is an OWNER decision. The A0 rerun reports a clean PRB-POS value for that adjudication; QB-ORD stays out of A0 itself pending the owner's ruling.
invalidated_as_evidence.architectural mismatch argument: the DESIGN-level argument (a single alpha-weighted mixture of clause-local answer distributions cannot preserve a selector-dependent intermediate entity) is architectural analysis and stands on its own -- but it is now UNMEASURED. P0's numbers neither support nor refute it.
